records.subject: Cu-S compounds
records.quote: Synergizing high performance and long-term stability in thermoelectric materials remains a formidable challenge, particularly for eco-friendly Cu-S compounds, which have outstanding performance but are plagued by thermal degradation at elevated temperatures and copper ion migration under electric fields.
